from fastmcp.client.transports import StdioTransport


async def main():
    transport = StdioTransport("python", ["server.py"])
    client = Client(transport)

        tools = await client.list_tools()
        print("Available tools:")

import asyncio

from fastmcp.client.transports import StdioTransport


async def main():
    transport = StdioTransport("python", ["server.py"])
    client = Client(transport)
    
    async with client:
        tools = await client.list_tools()

            print(f"  - {tool.name}")
